name: Agent ProofChain
audiences: Teams that need portable evidence for AI-agent authorization decisions
Agent-platform builders working across multiple model and runtime providers
Maintainers evaluating tamper-evident receipts and reproducible agent-policy tests
problems: Agent systems need a durable record of who requested an action and which capability was evaluated
Decision evidence should not expose raw prompts, secrets, or caller-controlled identity claims
Teams need independently verifiable receipt chains and deterministic evaluation fixtures

offers.name: Agent ProofChain CLI and evaluation foundation

claims.internalStatement: Agent ProofChain is a provider-neutral safety and evidence layer for AI-agent systems.
claims.publicWording: Evaluate agent capability requests and record portable evidence across model and runtime providers.

claims.internalStatement: Decision receipts store digests and form a SHA-256 hash chain that can be verified independently.
claims.publicWording: Write decision receipts into an independently verifiable SHA-256 hash chain without storing caller-controlled fields in plaintext.

claims.internalStatement: The v0.2 pilot includes a 40-case synthetic corpus, decision metrics, reason-code assertions, latency measurements, tamper tests, and provider-neutral adapter contracts.
claims.publicWording: Reproduce a 40-case synthetic evaluation covering identity, authorization, attribution, injection-shaped instructions, thresholds, and ledger tampering.

prohibitedClaims: Claims that ProofChain authenticates networks, issues credentials, sandboxes agents, or guarantees injection detection
Claims that the synthetic benchmark is a security certification or proves production effectiveness
Claims that hash chaining alone detects final-row truncation without an external signed checkpoint
